dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Even if an enemy is strong enough to fend me off for today, that doesn't faze me. Sooner or later, they will get their comeuppance.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: My vengeance may not always be swift... But it is always final.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: In your case, though... I seriously doubt there are many enemies out there who have what it takes to send you away bearing a grudge.
